confidence.exact: Translated to JavaScript; believed to match the real engine.
confidence.differs: Runs, but a known divergence from the real engine is listed.
confidence.cannot: Cannot emulate here: no result is produced.
confidence.error: The real engine rejects the pattern too.

models.rg: Line by line; -U over the whole file. --crlf makes $ match before \r\n.
models.grep: Line by line; -z makes NUL the record separator.
models.pwsh: Select-String line by line (ReadLine strips \r\n); -match, -cmatch and -replace on the whole string.
models.vsfind: The document with LF line endings; line by line unless the pattern has \n, \r or \W.
models.vssearch: ripgrep line by line with VS Code's toggles; --multiline when the pattern has \n; PCRE2 for look-around and backreferences.

flags.vsfind: Match Case, Whole Word, Regex, Preserve Case
flags.vssearch: Match Case, Whole Word, Regex, Preserve Case, files to include and exclude

replace.rg: -r: $1, ${1}, $name; $1 followed by digits is read as group 10 and up
replace.pwsh: -replace: $1, ${name}, $$; single quotes stop PowerShell's $ expansion, double quotes do not
